query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: symptom_acuity
per_column.rationale: Interpretable, well-separated ordinal categories (chronic/subacute/acute/sudden) derived from reason_for_visit; a natural axis to segment and compare against visit duration and urgency.

per_column.name: clinical_instability_present
per_column.rationale: Clean binary flag with a reasonable ~57/193 split; supports meaningful grouping (unstable vs stable) against duration.

per_column.name: diagnostic_intervention_intensity
per_column.rationale: Distinct, interpretable categories (none/lab/imaging/procedure) that plausibly drive visit duration; excellent segmentation variable for EDA.

per_column.name: primary_organ_system
per_column.rationale: Interpretable clinical categories usable for segmentation; some categories are very sparse (hematologic=1), slightly limiting comparison, but the top groups are well populated.

per_column.name: multi_system_involvement
per_column.rationale: Binary flag with balanced split; interpretable axis for comparing single vs multi-system cases against duration.

per_column.name: visit_reason_category
per_column.rationale: Interpretable categories, but this is essentially a recoding/taxonomy of the focus-adjacent reason_for_visit column already present, largely restating the existing predictor rather than adding an external associational variable.

per_column.name: chronic_disease_component
per_column.rationale: Balanced binary flag; interpretable segmentation (chronic vs not) to compare against urgency and duration, though partially overlaps symptom_acuity/visit_reason_category.

per_column.name: intervention_required
per_column.rationale: Well-separated, interpretable categories of care action that plausibly relate to duration; strong EDA segmentation variable.

judge.rationale: As a set, these columns open up genuinely informative, human-interpretable relationships around visit_duration_min: acuity, instability, diagnostic and intervention intensity, organ system, and chronicity are all external associational axes with clean, well-separated categories suitable for grouping and comparison against urgency, department, and age group. They avoid opaque scores and mechanical features. Deductions: visit_reason_category largely restates the existing reason_for_visit field, several binaries (chronic_disease_component, multi_system_involvement, clinical_instability) overlap conceptually with symptom_acuity and intervention columns, creating redundancy, and primary_organ_system has some near-empty categories limiting comparison. Overall a strong, mostly non-mechanical EDA set.
